title.zh: Strategy Q3财报：营业利润约209亿美元创新高，比特币持仓848,517枚，CFO将离任
title.en: Strategy Q3财报：营业利润约209亿美元创新高，比特币持仓848,517枚，CFO将离任

current_state.zh: Strategy reported Q3 operating profit of about $20.91 billion driven by digital-asset fair-value gains, disclosed holdings of 848,517 BTC, and announced that CFO Andrew Kang will leave on November 5 with CEO Phong Le serving as interim finance head.
